description: Independent copies for the six homepage light pillars. Avatar data stays in its existing catalog.

detail.title: Presence
detail.description: Voice, form, and movement—a new way of being present. You can hear it, see it, and notice the small gestures it makes as it speaks. Tone, posture, and responses work together, staying true to its original style. It is both a static model on your screen and a good friend in another digital world.

preview.title: Identity
preview.pillarDescription: An identity carried in a tilted nameplate.

detail.title: Identity
detail.description: An identity of its own, with a record of where it came from, who owns it, and who owned it before. A unique ID records each character’s origin, version, total number in existence, and ownership history. Even when you encounter characters that look the same, yours still has its own unique hash. If ownership changes, every transfer is recorded. You become a witness to its history.

preview.title: Continuity
preview.pillarDescription: Months, years, and a continuous flow of time.

detail.title: Continuity
detail.description: Memories keep growing, independent of the compute provider. Preacherman turns your conversations and shared experiences into memories, keeping what matters while allowing less important details to gradually fade. These memories are stored separately by Preacherman and locally on your device, independent of the compute provider.

preview.title: Autonomy
preview.pillarDescription: A body acting under its own drive.

detail.title: Autonomy
detail.description: It changes as it grows closer to you. It arrives with a personality of its own and gradually gets to know the world. Your conversations and the problems you encounter shape how it understands and responds. The same character, accompanying different people, develops different perspectives through those experiences. It does more than repeat its initial settings: through its time with you, it gradually becomes its own distinct self.

preview.title: Expression
preview.pillarDescription: Voice, text, and movement in one changing form.

detail.title: Expression
detail.description: A way of communicating all its own. A familiar voice, a distinctive tone, and speaking habits that are uniquely its own. Whether you are talking about everyday life or thinking through an idea together, its personality comes through. Even when the model behind it changes, its familiar way of expressing itself stays with it, so you can recognize that it is still the same companion speaking to you.

preview.title: Connection
preview.pillarDescription: A point growing into a connected plane.

detail.title: Connection
detail.description: Bring your virtual human along, meet up with friends and theirs, and share what is new. It can make friends of its own and tell you about new things it has encountered. You can add friends and gather in a small group with your virtual humans to catch up, exchange ideas, or play games together. When you share a project, your characters can enter the same space and divide up the work, extending conversations beyond just you and your companion.
